title: How geofencing can be switched
body_md: In two switch positions geofencing can be switched on and off by the voltage on pin 3. In all other switch positions it is switched by text message. Before geofencing can be used at a new location, it must first be deactivated at the previous one.
prev_context: Before this stands the explanation of the geofencing principle.
next_context: The red note on the automatic coupling to the alarm system follows.
